plan.line: a DHT22 (AM2302) sensor that measures the air's temperature (−40 to 80 °C, ±0.5 °C) and humidity (0 to 100 %, ±2 %), at most once every 2 seconds; its pull-up resistor is added automatically. Use it when the idea names a DHT22 or AM2302, or needs below-zero or more precise readings; otherwise the DHT11.

label: a DHT22 temperature and humidity sensor
DHT22 temperature and humidity sensors
names.supports: the DHT22 (AM2302) temperature and humidity sensor

code.pinLine: DHT22 temperature and humidity sensor {ref} on {gpio}: sensor = dht.DHT22(Pin({g})). Call sensor.measure(), then sensor.temperature() gives degrees C with one decimal and sensor.humidity() percent with one decimal. Wait 1 s after the program starts before the first measure(), and at least 2 s between measure() calls. measure() raises OSError when a reading fails (for example a loose wire): catch it and try again on the next round.
